title: Etsivä Romppainen ja Lakkahaltian Salaisuus
note: First vertical slice. Content is data, not code: the scene reads this file.

topics.label: Ask about the shared forest detail
topics.text: Three patients, one forest. None of them have met. The detail is not in any discharge leaflet we print.

topics.label: Ask about the trial
topics.text: There is a BCI pilot on this ward. I signed the protocol. I did not read the appendix.

topics.label: Ask what happens at night
topics.text: They draw the same building. A hall with no doors. Room 12 has been empty since spring.

topics.label: Ask who maintains the forest road
topics.text: The municipality. Though if you ask the inspector, the permit file is older than the road.

topics.label: Listen to what she remembers
topics.text: I remember a door with no hospital behind it. And a sound like someone tasting something for the first time.

check.on_success: You can tell she is describing an experience, not reciting one.
check.on_failure: You cannot tell. She notices that you cannot.

topics.label: Read her chart (Medicine)
topics.text: No psychosis history. No substance use. Normal scans. Whatever this is, the chart does not contain it.

check.on_success: The medication notes contradict the trial consent form.
check.on_failure: The notes are ambiguous. You would need the trial file.

clues.ev_shared_detail: Three patients name the same forest detail, absent from printed material.
clues.ev_trial: A BCI pilot runs on the ward; the physician signed an appendix he never read.
clues.ev_drawings: Night drawings show a hall with no doors. Room 12 is empty.
clues.ev_permits: The forest road permit file predates the road.
clues.ev_testimony: The patient describes an experience rather than reciting one.
clues.ev_chart: Chart contradicts the trial consent form.

publish.title: Ending: Publish
publish.text: You publish. The patients are named in a leaked appendix. Something in the forest is now a permit question, and the trial resumes under a new number.

contain.title: Ending: Contain
contain.text: You refer the file to UNSA and sign the containment order. The ward reopens on Monday. Nothing is explained, and nobody is told.
